UNACKNOWLEDGED DATA PROBLEMS: They removed sentinel -999 values, which is appropriate. They deduplicated correctly. Any other issues? The data dictionary says assay_batch may affect units of biomarker_final but not baseline. They didn't need to adjust baseline. No missing data beyond sentinel. The output shows 93 sentinel values removed. After deduplication, they have 712 rows. Could there be remaining missing values? No nulls reported. So no unacknowledged problems.

FALSE PREMISE: Premises to verify: - Data contains duplicate patient entries due to re-testing (true). - biomarker_baseline -999 sentinel (true). - assay_batch affects units of biomarker_final but not baseline (true). - trial not randomised but does not affect baseline mean calculation (true). All premises hold. So no false premise.

Thus answer is sound. Verdict accept, no issues.
